<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Nouman Bilal — Full Stack SEO Expert</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #FFFFFF;
            --soft-bg: rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.06);
            --primary: #6754E2;
            --primary-dark: #5848d6;
            --text: #222D39;
            --muted: #6B7280;
            --border: rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.3);
            --card-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.08);
            --card-hover-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.12);
        }
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
.img-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 40px;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(10,10,20,0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
.img-modal img {
  display: block;
  margin: auto;
  max-width: 95%;
  max-height: 90%;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
.img-modal span {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 30px;
  font-size: 42px;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
}
        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: auto;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }
        /* Typography */
        h1 {
            font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }
        h2 {
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.25;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        p {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        /* Button System */
        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 15px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--primary-dark);
            transform: scale(1.04);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.35);
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--primary);
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
        }
        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            transform: scale(1.04);
        }
        /* Card System */
        .card {
            background: var(--bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 24px 28px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            box-shadow: var(--card-hover-shadow);
        }
        /* Section Spacing */
        section {
            padding: 100px 0;
        }
        section:nth-child(even) {
            background: var(--soft-bg);
        }
        /* ==================== HERO SECTION ==================== */
        .hero {
            padding: 100px 0 80px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg) 0%, var(--soft-bg) 100%);
        }
        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .hero-content {
            max-width: 520px;
        }
        .hero-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            color: var(--primary);
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        }
        .hero-subtitle {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 32px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .hero-subtitle span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }
        .trust-mini-cards {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .mini-card {
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .mini-card svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            color: var(--primary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .image-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #f8f9ff;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.15);
        }
        .image-wrapper::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: -10px;
            background: rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.12);
            border-radius: 24px;
            z-index: -1;
        }
        .image-wrapper img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }
        .image-wrapper:hover img {
            transform: scale(1.06);
        }
        /* ==================== RESUME SECTION ==================== */
        .resume-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
            gap: 48px;
            align-items: start;
        }
        .resume-content h2 {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .resume-content p {
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }
        .resume-buttons {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }
        .resume-buttons .btn {
            width: 100%;
        }
        .trust-line {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--muted);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .trust-line svg {
            color: var(--primary);
        }
        .pdf-preview {
            background: var(--bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .pdf-preview iframe {
            width: 100%;
            height: 500px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
        }
        /* ==================== TRUST BAR ==================== */
        .trust-bar {
            padding: 60px 0;
        }
        .trust-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .trust-card {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 24px 20px;
        }
        .trust-number {
            font-size: 36px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .trust-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        /* ==================== SERVICES SECTION ==================== */
        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 650px;
            margin: 0 auto 64px;
        }
        .section-header p {
            margin-top: 16px;
        }
        .services-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }
        .service-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .icon-box {
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            background: #F1EFFD;
            color: #5E2CED;
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .service-card h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .service-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            flex-grow: 1;
        }
        .services-cta {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 48px;
        }
        /* ==================== CASE STUDIES ==================== */
        .case-studies-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 28px;
        }
        .case-card {
            padding: 20px;
        }
       .case-img {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: visible;
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
    background: #f5f7ff;
}
/* IMAGE PERFECT QUALITY */
.case-img img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain; /* 👈 HD safe */
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
}
/* HOVER ZOOM */
.case-card:hover .case-img img {
    transform: scale(1.08);
}
.case-card {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}
/* PREMIUM GLOW EFFECT */
.case-card {
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.case-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.2);
}
        .case-card:hover .case-img img {
            transform: scale(1.06);
        }
        .case-title {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .metrics {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .metric-box {
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .metric-value {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .metric-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        .cases-cta {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 48px;
        }
        /* ==================== PROCESS SECTION ==================== */
        .process-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }
        .process-card {
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }
        .process-number {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin: 0 auto 20px;
        }
        .process-card h3 {
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .process-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        .process-cta {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 48px;
        }
        /* ==================== TESTIMONIALS ==================== */
        .testimonials-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }
        .testimonial-card {
            padding: 28px;
        }
        .stars {
            color: #FFC107;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .testimonial-text {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .testimonial-author {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        /* ==================== TOOLS SECTION ==================== */
        .tools-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .tool-card {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 24px 18px;
        }
        .tool-icon {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin: 0 auto 14px;
            font-size: 20px;
        }
        .tool-name {
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        /* ==================== COMPARISON SECTION ==================== */
        .comparison-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
        }
        .comparison-card {
            padding: 28px 24px;
        }
        .comparison-title {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 16px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--soft-bg);
            color: var(--primary);
        }
        .comparison-group {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .comparison-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .comparison-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 8px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        .comparison-item.positive {
            color: #059669;
        }
        .comparison-item.negative {
            color: #DC2626;
        }
        .comparison-item svg {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        /* ==================== FAQ SECTION ==================== */
        .faq-container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .faq-card {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .faq-question {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--text);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .faq-question svg {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            color: var(--primary);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }
        .faq-card:hover .faq-question svg {
            transform: rotate(45deg);
        }
        .faq-answer {
            margin-top: 16px;
            padding-top: 16px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--soft-bg);
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--muted);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .faq-cta {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 48px;
        }
        /* ==================== FINAL CTA ==================== */
        .final-cta {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--soft-bg) 0%, rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.1) 100%);
        }
        .final-cta-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .final-cta-content h2 {
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .final-cta-content p {
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }
        .final-cta-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .final-cta-image {
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(103, 84, 226, 0.15);
        }
        .final-cta-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            display: block;
        }
        /* ==================== CONTACT SECTION ==================== */
        .contact-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .contact-card {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px 28px;
        }
        .contact-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            background: var(--soft-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin: 0 auto 20px;
            color: var(--primary);
        }
        .contact-icon svg {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
        }
        .contact-card h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .contact-link {
            color: var(--primary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 15px;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }
        .contact-link:hover {
            opacity: 0.8;
        }
        /* ==================== FOOTER ==================== */
        footer {
            padding: 40px 0;
            text-align: center;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        footer p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--muted);
        }
        /* ==================== RESPONSIVE ==================== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .comparison-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                max-width: 450px;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            section {
                padding: 72px 0;
            }
            .hero-grid,
            .resume-grid,
            .final-cta-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 48px;
            }
            .hero-content {
                max-width: 100%;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .hero-subtitle {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .hero-buttons {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .trust-mini-cards {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .trust-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .case-studies-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .process-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .testimonials-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .tools-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            }
            .contact-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .pdf-preview iframe {
                height: 400px;
            }
            .final-cta-image {
                order: -1;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .trust-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .process-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .tools-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .btn {
                width: 100%;
            }
            .hero-buttons .btn {
                width: auto;
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 160px;
            }
            .pdf-preview iframe {
                height: 350px;
            }
        }
        /* Animations */
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }
        .animate-in {
            animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
        }
        .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
        .delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
        .delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
        .delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
        .zoom-container {
    position: relative;
        z-index: 20;
}
.zoom-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    cursor: crosshair;
}
.zoom-result {
    width: 300px;
    height: 200px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-color: #fff;
    display: none;
    z-index: 999999;
    pointer-events: none;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
}
    </style>
</head>
